# About us {#about} 

Our research focuses on aging epidemiology, with an emphasis on understanding longevity, preventive strategies for disease and disability, and the management of age-related health issues in older populations. 

<!-- Our work uses epidemiological methods, including causal inference, and demographic approaches, analyzing various data sources such as administrative records (registers and healthcare insurance data), cohort data, and open data as long as they fit our research theme. -->

We welcome collaborations with researchers having diverse backgrounds.

::: {style="font-size: 1.3rem;"}
**Longevity and Healthy Longevity**
:::

 We investigate the determinants of longevity and healthy aging. Current research projects include comparing older adults' health and healthcare between Japan and Sweden.

::: {style="font-size: 1.3rem;"}
**Issues in Older Adults, Especially Dementia**
:::

We investigate critical health related challenges that affect quality of life and independence in the older population. Our research addresses both chronic conditions such as dementia and musculoskeletal pain and its impact on disability and cognitive function, as well as dementia-related issues including getting lost and wandering behavior.

::: {style="font-size: 1.3rem;"}
**Keywords**: Longevity; Healthy longevity; Dementia; Disability; Long-term care; Epidemiology; Demography
:::

# Join our team {#join-our-team}

::: {style="font-size: 1.3rem;"}
**JSPS Postdoctoral Fellowship from abroad**
:::

This program allows **researchers from abroad** to stay in Japan, and then conduct research at Japanese institutions. We would be pleased to host fellows under this program. If you are interested in joining our group through this fellowship, please contact Shunsuke Murata.

It provides comprehensive support, including:

**Key Features:**  
- Monthly living allowance    
- Research activity allowance  
- International travel expenses  
- Overseas travel insurance etc

For detailed information about eligibility, application procedures, and timeline, please visit:

[**JSPS Postdoctoral Fellowship**](https://www.jsps.go.jp/english/e-fellow/e-ippan/index.html){target="_blank"}

JSPS also offers [**short-term programs**](https://www.jsps.go.jp/english/e-fellow/index.html){target="_blank"}.

# Publications {#publications}

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| results: asis

# Install packages if needed
library(httr)
library(jsonlite)

# Function to check if name contains Japanese characters
is_japanese <- function(name) {
  grepl("[\u3040-\u309F\u30A0-\u30FF\u4E00-\u9FFF]", name)
}

# Function to convert "Firstname Middlename Lastname" to "Lastname FM"
format_author_name <- function(name) {
  name <- trimws(name)
  
  if (is_japanese(name)) {
    return(name)
  }
  
  parts <- strsplit(name, "\\s+")[[1]]
  
  if (length(parts) >= 2) {
    surname <- parts[length(parts)]
    given_names <- parts[1:(length(parts)-1)]
    initials <- paste(substr(given_names, 1, 1), collapse = "")
    return(paste0(surname, " ", initials))
  } else {
    return(name)
  }
}

# Fetch data from researchmap
url <- "https://api.researchmap.jp/muratas/published_papers"
response <- GET(url)
data <- fromJSON(content(response, "text", encoding = "UTF-8"))

# Get publications
pubs <- data$items

# Sort by year
pubs <- pubs[order(-as.integer(substr(pubs$publication_date, 1, 4)), na.last = TRUE), ]

# Get unique years
years <- unique(as.integer(substr(pubs$publication_date, 1, 4)))
years <- sort(years[!is.na(years)], decreasing = TRUE)

# Start wrapper divs
cat('<div id="publication-list">\n')
cat('<div class="visible-pubs">\n\n')

# Display publications
pub_count <- 0

for (year in years) {
  year_pubs <- pubs[as.integer(substr(pubs$publication_date, 1, 4)) == year, ]
  
  for (i in 1:nrow(year_pubs)) {
    pub_count <- pub_count + 1
    
    # Switch to hidden div after 5 publications
    if (pub_count == 6) {
      cat('</div>\n')
      cat('<div class="hidden-pubs" style="display: none;">\n\n')
    }
    
    pub <- year_pubs[i, ]
    
    # Title
    title <- pub$paper_title$ja
    if (is.na(title) || is.null(title)) title <- pub$paper_title$en
    if (is.na(title) || is.null(title)) title <- "タイトルなし"
    
    # Authors
    authors <- NULL
    if (!is.null(pub$authors$ja[[1]])) {
      authors <- pub$authors$ja[[1]]
    } else if (!is.null(pub$authors$en[[1]])) {
      authors <- pub$authors$en[[1]]$name
    }
    
    if (!is.null(authors) && length(authors) > 0) {
      authors <- as.character(unlist(authors))
      authors <- sapply(authors, format_author_name, USE.NAMES = FALSE)
      author_text <- paste(authors, collapse = ", ")
    } else {
      author_text <- "著者不明"
    }
    
    # Make your name bold
    author_text <- gsub("村田 峻輔", "**村田 峻輔**", author_text)
    author_text <- gsub("Murata S", "**Murata S**", author_text)
    
    # Journal
    journal <- ifelse(is.na(pub$publication_name$en) || is.null(pub$publication_name$en), 
                      "", pub$publication_name$en)
    
    # Volume/issue/pages
    vol_info <- ""
    if (!is.na(pub$volume) && !is.null(pub$volume)) vol_info <- pub$volume
    if (!is.na(pub$number) && !is.null(pub$number)) vol_info <- paste0(vol_info, "(", pub$number, ")")
    if (!is.na(pub$starting_page) && !is.null(pub$starting_page)) {
      pages <- pub$starting_page
      if (!is.na(pub$ending_page) && !is.null(pub$ending_page)) {
        pages <- paste0(pages, "-", pub$ending_page)
      }
      vol_info <- paste0(year, ";", vol_info, ":", pages)
    }
    
    # DOI
    doi_text <- ""
    if (!is.null(pub$identifiers$doi[[1]]) && length(pub$identifiers$doi[[1]]) > 0) {
      doi_url <- paste0("https://doi.org/", pub$identifiers$doi[[1]][1])
      doi_text <- paste0("[", doi_url, "](", doi_url, "){target='_blank'}")
    }
    
    # Output citation
    cat(pub_count, ". ", title, "<br>\n", sep = "")
    cat(author_text, "<br>\n", sep = "")
    if (journal != "") {
      cat("*", journal, "*", sep = "")
      if (vol_info != "") cat(", ", vol_info, sep = "")
      cat("<br>\n")
    }
    if (doi_text != "") cat(doi_text, "<br>\n", sep = "")
    cat("\n")
  }
}

# Close divs and add button if more than 5 publications
cat('</div>\n')

if (pub_count > 5) {
  cat('\n<button id="show-more-btn" onclick="togglePublications()">Show more</button>\n')
}

cat('</div>\n')

# Add JavaScript
cat('
<script>
function togglePublications() {
  const hiddenPubs = document.querySelector(".hidden-pubs");
  const btn = document.getElementById("show-more-btn");
  
  if(hiddenPubs.style.display === "none") {
    hiddenPubs.style.display = "block";
    btn.textContent = "Show less";
  } else {
    hiddenPubs.style.display = "none";
    btn.textContent = "Show more";
  }
}
</script>
')
```
